value.body: A two-year Master's in a foreign language such as French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese or Russian. It builds advanced proficiency and covers literature, linguistics, translation and, in some universities, interpretation and language teaching methods.

items.label: Postgraduate students in non-English foreign languages
items.note: French, German, Spanish and other foreign languages, excluding English
items.source: AISHE 2023-24, Table 13, actual responses (Ministry of Education)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree in the language, or proof of advanced proficiency for some programmes. Central universities admit through CUET-PG; others hold their own entrance tests.

value.title: At a glance
items: Seats are limited and offered by a relatively small number of universities.
It is the usual base for UGC-NET in the language, a Ph.D., and college teaching.
Translation, interpretation and localisation work value proven proficiency as much as the degree.
